[size=5][b]"Community Remaster":[/b][/size]
"Community Remaster",is a full rework in which old events will be remade and new ones will be added, features that I abandoned at the time will be implemented, and translations will be added. For more effective work on the "Community Remaster" version, it was decided to create a discord channel for feedback, please do not hesitate to leave comments.


[b]*Manual is under rework, if you have any questions check F.A.Q. or ask your question on discord server.
*This mod is for male character only!(for now).[/b]
[b]*I have removed the paywall from Patreon content, so development for the female character is now passive. (To be clear, she hasn't been forgotten! We are actually creating different variations of her events and dialogues, though some bugs may occur).[/b]
So, the main goal of LewdDew Valley is to build a proper sexual relationship system, not just between the player and NPCs, but between the NPCs themselves too! To make this happen, I designed a "Lewdness System."

Essentially, this system adds a hidden copy of each NPC representing their "Lewd Essence." Building friendship with this essence is what allows you to unlock NSFW versions of their events. Progress is tied to regular NPC events: for example, finishing Abigail's classic 2-heart event unlocks a "date" with her. Completing that date boosts your friendship with both Abigail and her Lewd Essence, paving the way for a potential NSFW 4-heart event. 

I built this to make intimacy feel much more natural. To me, jumping straight into a sex scene during an early 4-heart event feels weird. This way, you can play through the story as a "good friend" or a "true lover" with realistic, step-by-step sexual progress. And of course, once you marry an NPC, their events become repeatable and you don't need to worry about their Lewd Essence anymore—after the wedding, the intimacy is already a given!
